Last week, a helpful note for pet owners
It concerns the desk
Travel notice for companion animals

Travelers should check in early with the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways so the team can review pet papers, carrier details, and cabin or hold plans before departure. A calm start helps the staff guide each step and keeps your trip moving smoothly.

Bring clear records, keep food and water ready, and make sure your animal is settled in an approved carrier. <<FACT F082>> If you are traveling with a rabbit, the desk can also help you understand what must be shown at check-in. The senior coordinator reviews unusual cases and the trained staff give patient help to every animal.

Please read your travel papers carefully, then speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk before you head to the airport.
